name: Fibonacci Retracement Calculator
meta_description: Calculate Fibonacci retracement and extension levels from a swing high and low, for an uptrend or a downtrend, with distance from the current price.
subtitle: Work out Fibonacci retracement and extension price levels from a swing high and swing low, for an upward or a downward move.

Levels are price points worked out from the swing, not forecasts of where the price will go.

Retracement levels

Where a pullback against the move would reach each ratio. 0% is the end of the move and 100% is its start.

LevelPriceFrom current price

Extension levels

Projections beyond the end of the move, measured from its start as a share of the swing: 161.8% is 1.618 times the swing from the starting price.
